notes: The reachable no-argument listing uses overlapping sprintf input/output; the shipped Linux C oracle emits an unstable/empty listing, so it is retained as an explicit undefined-behavior exclusion (R1/R5e).
Both exit and exits spellings toggle PRF_AUTOEXIT and emit the exact on/off lines in both directions across the five-seed vehicle.
Loot toggles the corpse-looting preference and emits the exact on/off lines in both directions across the five-seed vehicle.
Gold toggles corpse-gold collection and emits the exact on/off lines in both directions across the five-seed vehicle.
Split toggles group gold sharing and emits the exact on/off lines in both directions across the five-seed vehicle.
C compares the post-skip-spaces argument literally; uppercase EXIT reaches the unknown-argument response rather than toggling exits.
Unknown arguments emit What do you want to make automatic? without state change.
